# Bonooru conformance vectors (AD-14). Format: vectors/README.md.
# Generated by an independent implementation and reviewed by hand;
# a wire change edits these files first.
#
# frames.txt: payload (type seq body) + wire (COBS, no delimiter), optional rx;
# or wire + err (+ rx, + payload when the frame is also an encode check).
proto_version: 01

# PING whose CRC contains a 00 byte (crc 00 f2 on the wire) (6 encoded bytes)
crc_has_zero.payload: 06 38
crc_has_zero.wire: 03 06 38 01 02 f2

# HEARTBEAT (bridge range) accepted by the controller (10 encoded bytes)
heartbeat.payload: 40 07 00 01 00 01
heartbeat.wire: 04 40 07 04 02 01 04 01 74 4a

# type 7f, the top of the controller receive range (6 encoded bytes)
boundary_7f_controller.payload: 7f 00
boundary_7f_controller.wire: 02 7f 01 03 a5 38

# type 80, the bottom of the app receive range (6 encoded bytes)
boundary_80_app.payload: 80 00
boundary_80_app.wire: 02 80 01 03 c6 f7
boundary_80_app.rx: APP

# type ff, the top of the app receive range (7 encoded bytes)
boundary_ff_app.payload: ff 10 01
boundary_ff_app.wire: 07 ff 10 01 01 10 af
boundary_ff_app.rx: APP

# type 07: in range but unassigned, decodes (the semantic layer NAKs it) (6 encoded bytes)
unassigned_07.payload: 07 03
unassigned_07.wire: 03 07 03 03 5f 1c

# seq ff (wrap point), SET_STATE NEUTRAL (14 encoded bytes)
seq_ff.payload: 02 ff 00 00 08 80 80 80 80 00
seq_ff.wire: 04 02 ff 08 01 06 08 80 80 80 80 03 2f e2

# type 00, seq 00, empty body: encodes, then out of range on decode
all_zero_type_seq.payload: 00 00
all_zero_type_seq.wire: 01 01 01 03 9c cc
all_zero_type_seq.err: RANGE

# type 00 with a body: valid CRC, out of range for both sides
type_00.payload: 00 05 01
type_00.wire: 01 06 05 01 01 20 4c
type_00.err: RANGE

# type 00 as seen by the app
type_00_app.wire: 01 06 05 01 01 20 4c
type_00_app.err: RANGE
type_00_app.rx: APP

# type 80 as seen by the controller
type_80_controller.wire: 02 80 01 03 c6 f7
type_80_controller.err: RANGE

# type 01 as seen by the app
type_01_app.wire: 02 01 05 01 01 64 d1
type_01_app.err: RANGE
type_01_app.rx: APP

# type 40 (bridge heartbeat) as seen by the app
type_40_app.wire: 02 40 02 04 02 01 04 01 35 82
type_40_app.err: RANGE
type_40_app.rx: APP

# STOP with the last bit of the CRC flipped
bad_crc.wire: 02 05 01 03 6c 26
bad_crc.err: CRC

# STOP with the CRC bytes big-endian (wrong order)
crc_swapped.wire: 02 05 01 03 27 6c
crc_swapped.err: CRC

# STOP with a bit flipped in type: CRC, not range
bad_crc_type_flip.wire: 02 04 01 03 6c 27
bad_crc_type_flip.err: CRC

# len 02 but one body byte (CRC computed over the bytes sent)
len_too_large.wire: 02 01 05 02 01 37 84
len_too_large.err: CRC

# len 00 but one body byte (CRC computed over the bytes sent)
len_too_small.wire: 02 01 01 04 01 55 e2
len_too_small.err: CRC

# STOP missing its last raw byte, re-encoded: 4 raw bytes
truncated_raw.wire: 02 05 01 02 6c
truncated_raw.err: CRC

# STOP wire missing its last byte: the code byte points past the end
truncated_wire.wire: 02 05 01 03 6c
truncated_wire.err: COBS

# encoded 01 decodes to zero bytes: too short, a CRC error (D10)
decoded_len_0.wire: 01
decoded_len_0.err: CRC

# a 00 inside the encoded frame
zero_in_wire.wire: 02 05 00 03 6c 27
zero_in_wire.err: COBS
